profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am an experienced senior software engineer with a strong background in IoT applications for both smart homes and vehicles. At General Motors, I contribute to the Customer Care After-Sales Service Engineering organization, where I lead the development and management of advanced tools and service information to support vehicle diagnostics and warranty processes.

My core strengths include strategic leadership, effective communication, and problem-solving to drive scalable and high-performing technical solutions. Throughout my career, I’ve demonstrated a deep technical acumen and a proactive approach to managing technical debt while maintaining rigorous IT security standards. I excel in collaborative environments and am passionate about delivering innovative, high-quality solutions that elevate the customer experience.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: As an Asset Owner at General Motors, I manage technical debts and uphold high standards for IT systems. I also provide leadership by leading cross-functional teams to ensure product excellence and alignment with business objectives.

positions.title: Development Lead
positions.description: I lead the development of IoT applications for smart vehicle diagnostics and warranty processes at General Motors. My expertise includes implementing MQTT network protocols and robust backend systems for scalability and performance efficiency.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: As a software developer, I collaborated with GM's manufacturing team to develop end-of-line tools for the plastic mold shop, ensuring efficiency and reliability in the production of vehicle front and back bumpers. My work focused on enhancing production processes and optimizing assembly operations for improved quality and productivity.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Awarded a scholarship, I conducted research on Vehicle Ad Hoc Networks (VANNET), running complex simulations to study and enhance network protocols and security measures. Additionally, I developed solutions for big data challenges, focusing on machine learning algorithms such as K-means clustering techniques.
positions.insights: Skills: C · C++ · Software Engineering · Research

positions.title: Engineering Consultant
positions.description: Following my relocation to Texas, I transitioned to a remote role with Sabiamed as an Engineering Consultant, specializing in quality assurance for healthcare technologies. I provided ongoing expertise and support remotely, ensuring the reliability and performance of critical systems.

positions.title: Quality Assurance
positions.description: As a Quality Assurance Specialist, I ensure the reliability and performance of healthcare technologies used at hospital entry points. I implemented rigorous testing protocols to maintain high standards of functionality, usability, and regulatory compliance for critical healthcare systems.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: During my internship at Texas Tech University, I contributed to an ongoing research project aimed at improving the fast translation layer on SSD hardware. I developed a tool to define and model data, which was instrumental in feeding SSD simulation tools to enhance research outcomes.

honors.title: Awarded with scholarship for graduate school
